claims.how: The app's value of 4 sits within the measured range from 2.6 to 3.3 (R2), 3.3 to 4.8 (R3, R4), 3.95 (R11) and 8.7 to 11.5 (R5); it is graded g because it is the app's pick across several species.
The value 125 is the middle of the 120 to 130 degree panoramic field given for bottlenose dolphins and dolphins.
The one-cone statement comes from R46 and R186; the pigment peaks come from R28, R29 and R36, and the matrix weights themselves are the app's.
